business_summary: Zhejiang CONBA Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of pharmaceuticals and health products in China. It offers medicines, Chinese patent medicines, chemical medicines, Chinese herbal medicine slices, and health products. The company also provides Chinese decoction pieces; over-the-counter medications; healthy consumer products, including nutritional supplements, hygiene products, healthy daily chemicals and food, and other self-care products; and processes agricultural products. In addition, it offers prescription pieces, formula granules, plant extracts, and other products. The company offers its products under Aokang, Jindi, Jinaikang, Qianliekang, Tianbaoning, Jinkang Su, Li, Zhixinyan, Kang Enbei, Baozhilin, and Yangyingtang brands. The company was formerly known as Lanxi Yunshan Pharmaceutical Factory and changed its name to Zhejiang CONBA Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. in October 1999. Zhejiang CONBA Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

Zhejiang CONBA Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. 1969년에 설립되었으며 중국 항저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
